card.name: Inside square brackets
card.fires_on: The first word, letter or symbol right after an opening square bracket or within a bracketed aside. It also fires on a number or percent sign inside brackets.

modes.label: Start of bracketed text
modes.description: The first word or letter just after an opening square bracket, often in citations or inserted editorial text.

modes.label: Inside bracketed numbers
modes.description: A colon or percent sign within brackets holding numbers or ratios.

card.plain: It lights up on the first bit of text just inside square brackets, such as in citations, units or inserted notes.
